subject: Film & Cinema
title: Color Theory in Cinema
description: A short lesson to help you apply Color Theory in Cinema.

hook.text: Wes Anderson uses pastels for whimsy. Fincher uses desaturation for dread. Color is emotion.

buildup.text: Warm tones feel safe and nostalgic. Cool tones feel alienating and clinical.

discovery.text: The Matrix used green tinting inside the simulation and blue in the real world — visual coding.

twist.text: Digital color grading lets filmmakers change a film's entire palette in post-production.

climax.text: Color in cinema works subconsciously — audiences feel it before they understand it.

punchline.text: You feel the color before you see it.

quiz.question: What color scheme did The Matrix use inside the simulation?
